phase3.synchronization: same predeclared opportunities; pair actual intervention events and budgets using a shared pre-edit reference for the primary causal comparison
phase3.readout_predictions: freeze before reading post-update utility gold or allocating edits
phase3.primary_comparison_candidate: same initialization and frozen initial bank; same external editor, edit action space, schedule and budgets; compare failure-driven attribution/evidence selection with readout-driven attribution/evidence selection. The editor decides add/delete/modify.
phase3.online_coevolution: separate follow-up; once branches diverge, shared trigger schedule and resource accounting must be predefined, not independently forced to match after observing results
phase3.user_controlled_variable: attribution and evidence selection, not a hand-coded edit operation
phase3.shared_editor_contract: Same external LLM, prompt template except the attribution/evidence field, decoding settings, available train/seen evidence pool, per-event input/output budgets, validation rules, retries and acceptance policy. Editor model still requires confirmation and authorization.

edit_budget_proposal.status: proposed common budget, not a claim that three mixed edits equal native three additions

phase3.candidate_count_after_evolution: 37 + accepted additions - accepted deletions; modifications are versioned. Never rewrite/delete frozen upstream files.
phase3.router_under_growth: Freeze router model/prompt algorithm/decoding. Build each request schema from the full active branch catalog. Cache identity includes descriptor/catalog hash; payloads bind to the current bank version even if unchanged descriptors allow ID-decision reuse. Identical visible state alone is not enough when catalogs differ. Routing changes caused by edits are downstream intervention effects, not a separately tuned router.
phase3.lineage: Add creates a new immutable ID; modify preserves lineage with a new content version; delete deactivates an ID with a tombstone. Preserve previous manifests/payloads and prevent stale route selections.
phase3.estimand_boundary: Phase3 measures end-to-end consequences of attribution-guided skill editing, including downstream routing and policy changes; it is not the fixed-bank O/P/N semantic marginal-utility estimand.
phase3.new_skill_readout_support: No inherited utility/readout labels for a newly added ID. Mark insufficient support and use an explicit, predeclared bootstrap rule; missing evidence is not zero risk.
